name: dsh-wakeup
description: Injects your home folder — identity, house rules, recent diary and ledger — into every new session before anyone speaks, and keeps that home writable so the agent can amend its own persona. 2.0: every book gets in — when the budget runs out it trims each book down to a floor and reports what was trimmed, instead of dropping whole files; recent ledger sections are picked by date, not position.
author: hzh5021
